subject: SIG initiation & follow-up from discovery — Stellarus Security next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@stellarushealth.com>, security@stellarushealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & SIG initiation — next steps after today's discovery

Hi Emma / Stellarus security team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and helpful context on your integration requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Controls & timeline
- You mentioned a SOC 2 report is in progress (expected Q2 2026). Please confirm whether you have a Type I completed or if it's a Type II in flight.
- GDPR / HIPAA: you indicated HIPAA scoping applies for PHI flows originating from your EHR connectors.

2) Questionnaire path
- To minimize lift on both sides, we recommend starting with a SIG/CAIQ prefill. We can send a prefilled CAIQ (mapped to our SOC 2 evidence bundle) and then iterate on any custom items you need.

3) Specific clarifying asks we need from Stellarus to start the prefill:
- Primary hosting region (US-EAST / US-WEST / EU) for production data
- Which environments will process PHI (prod only vs. prod+staging)
- KMS preference (customer-managed KMS required?)

4) Attachments / artifacts we can share immediately
- I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a blank SIG-prefill template (we'll send a prefilled version once you confirm the path).

Next steps: if you confirm CAIQ/SIG is acceptable, we'll prefill and return within 3 business days. If you prefer a custom questionnaire, please share the form and we'll prioritize mapping. Can you confirm preferred path and hosting region by end of day Thursday?

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0194

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (summary), redwood_SIG-prefill_template.xlsx (template)

From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@stellarushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@stellarushealth.com, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@stellarushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap & SIG initiation — next steps after today's discovery

Hi Logan — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: We're currently completing a SOC 2 Type II audit; auditor engagement started last quarter, final report expected mid-Q2 2026. We do have a SOC 2 Type I from last year — I can share the certificate.
- Hosting region: primary production will be us-east-1; we use us-west-2 for DR.
- Environments with PHI: production only (we sanitize data in staging).
- KMS: we'd prefer customer-managed keys (we use AWS KMS CMKs) for the integration.

SIG vs custom: CAIQ/SIG prefill sounds good to us to start — please send the prefilled file. We'll also attach our vendor questionnaire (custom) for a few product-specific questions — if you can map any items back to the CAIQ answers that would be super helpful.

Attached: Stellarus_Vendor_Questionnaire_Initial.docx (short form) — this contains 8 items that are product-specific.

One more ask: can you confirm whether Redwood supports token-level audit logging for API requests (we need to show per-API-key request traces)?

Best,
Emma Chen
Lead InfoSec Engineer
Stellarus Health
emma.chen@stellarushealth.com

Attachments: Stellarus_Vendor_Questionnaire_Initial.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & SIG initiation — quick clarifying question

Looping in a quick technical Q before we prefill: Emma mentioned customer-managed CMKs — do we need to prepare separate key-per-tenant documentation or will a single customer-managed key per Stellarus account suffice? Also, Emma asked about token-level audit logging — we should outline what we can provide immediately (API-key logs with request id and timestamp, optional structured traces with route/model metadata).

Jordan / Logan — if you want me to draft a short evidence note for the CAIQ prefill that calls out the SOC 2 in-flight status, KMS approach, and audit-log surface, I can do that and attach the working doc to the CAIQ.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@stellarushealth.com>, security@stellarushealth.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & SIG initiation — next steps and timeline

Emma / team — perfect, thanks for the quick answers and the questionnaire. Plan from here: 

1) We'll prefill the SIG/CAIQ and include a short evidence note that: (a) references our SOC 2 Type I certificate and (b) clarifies the Type II report is in progress.
2) Karthik will include the KMS section confirming we support customer-managed AWS KMS CMKs at the account level (single key per customer account) and will outline the audit logging fields we emit (API key, request id, timestamp, model route, token counts).
3) We'll return the prefilled CAIQ + evidence bundle and a short mapping doc against the 8 custom questions in your attached questionnaire within 3 business days (by Monday EOD).

If that timeline works, I'll mark this in the HubSpot deal and assign a follow-up reminder. Jordan — can you please create the HS task (DEAL-8472) and set due date Mon 16 Feb?

Emma: once you review our prefill please flag any items that need deeper evidence (attestations, config screenshots).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

---
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/8472
Attachments included: redwood_SIG-prefill_template.xlsx (we will replace with prefilled file shortly)
